_note: Impact figures for nila.land/how#impact. Hardcoded for now; later rewritten by a scheduled job (Lambda or the sensing node). A null value = not measured yet. Food: kg/ha per crop against the same fields' baseline.

metrics.name: Food
metrics.def: Harvest per hectare on her fields, against the same fields before Nila.
metrics.source: Crop shares on Stellar (estimated yield, then the harvest record); baseline from district yield per crop and each field's satellite record.
metrics.when: First crop shares on Stellar, season 2026–27.

metrics.name: Income
metrics.def: Monthly income of a member’s household, against the average farm household in Tamil Nadu.
metrics.source: Baseline: NSO SAS 77th round (2019). Members: union books or app survey.

compare.label: Tamil Nadu farm household, 2018–19
compare.source: NSO Situation Assessment Survey, 77th round (2019): average monthly income of an agricultural household, Tamil Nadu. Not adjusted for inflation since.

compare.label: Nila members
compare.source: The union's books or a short survey in the app, after the 2026–27 year.

metrics.name: Women’s land
metrics.def: Land titles held in a woman’s own name.
metrics.figure: About 90% of union members are women (the unions’ figure). Titles by name: not counted yet.
metrics.source: Land titles (Polygon, Stellar) matched against the union's member list.
metrics.when: Count from the title list, with the unions.

metrics.name: Independence
metrics.def: Share of the union’s fund that is the members’ own savings, not outside money.
metrics.figure: ₹2.43 lakh of ₹10.08 lakh deposited (Polygon, GroundUp Fund). Closed crop shares repaid in full: 39 of 39.

metrics.name: Her voice
metrics.def: Members who say their life is better than a year ago, in a short survey.
metrics.source: Survey in the app or by the union leader.
metrics.when: First survey after the 2026–27 Samba harvest.
